speaker: Mr Leong Mun Wai
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what is HDB's net loss for the Central Weave BTO project at Ang Mo Kio; (b) what is the cost of land paid by HDB to SLA for this project; and (c) what is the net profit and loss position for the Government, including HDB and SLA, for this project.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: This is determined independently by the Chief Valuer, using market valuation principles.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: Hence, when HDB uses the land for development, the money that HDB will need to pay for the land must be paid back into the Past Reserves, which are invested and grown for future generations and are protected.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: The Government cannot use proceeds from land sales as revenue for spending in the Budget.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: HDB does not price new flats based on cost.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: When pricing new flats, HDB first establishes their market value by considering the prices of comparable resale flats nearby as well as the individual attributes of the flats and prevailing market conditions.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: To derive the selling prices, HDB applies a significant subsidy to the assessed market values to ensure that new flats are affordable to those buying their first home.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: On top of this, HDB provides further grants, such as the Enhanced CPF Housing Grant, the Proximity Housing Grant and the Step-Up CPF Housing Grant, among others, to help specific demographic groups with their home ownership aspirations.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: HDB incurs a significant deficit every year, as the amount that it collects from the sale of flats is far less than the cost of its building programme and the housing grants it disburses each year.

speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
text: HDB will continue to ensure that public housing remains affordable and accessible for all Singaporeans.
